summary: Creates the first CMSIS csolution for a verified board or device, either a minimal project or an example or template of its pack, then opens and builds it with cmsis_action.
triggers: Create the first CMSIS solution for a board or device
a folder that has no *.csolution.yml yet
Use from cmsis-bootstrap or cmsis-project when a new project has to be started
a new project has to be started for a verified board, device and pack
stop_conditions: the folder, which must not contain a `*.csolution.yml` (stop and name `proc-add-cmsis-target` (`knowledge_get`) when it does);
Show the user the qualifying entries with their descriptions and let them choose, the minimal project always among the options.
ask when the name does not fit
ask when the chosen one is not listed.
stop and report when there is none.
take the core the user named, otherwise ask which one; when the user does not care, the first core the DFP lists is the boot core, say so in the report
ask when it was not named; the first listed core is the boot core
Show the variants it names, let the user choose, write the full identifier (for example `Device:Startup&C Startup`) into the cproject, build again
Remove the rendered files, report it, and offer an example or template of the pack (step 3), or `proc-add-board-layer` (`knowledge_get`) once a solution exists.
Ask the user to answer the prompts of the Arm Tools Environment Manager and the CMSIS Solution extension in the window, then build again
with `AC6` the user must accept the licence once

extracted.title: Multi-core devices need Dname:Pname
extracted.body: A device with several processors (the DFP lists more than one `Pname`, as the MCXN947 does with `cm33_core0` and `cm33_core1`) needs `Dname:Pname`: take the core the user named, otherwise ask which one; when the user does not care, the first core the DFP lists is the boot core, say so in the report
